name: Gianni
site: radissonhotels.com · Hotel group and rewards, Belgium
headline: Turn Radisson’s booking data into repeat stays.
saw: Your homepage sells stays, the Black Friday offer of up to 35% off, Member Only Rate and Plan & Save to every visitor in the same way, whether they arrive for a city break or a family trip.

After booking, the stays a guest repeats, the dates they move and the points they never spend are your strongest signal for the next stay. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the guest receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention offers for stays are built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to lapse this week gets the same mail as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per guest, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the guest who is drifting away
cases.text: Spots the guest drifting away from a repeat stay, using booking gaps and rewards activity. Picks the offer, channel and moment for each guest, and tests it continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right next stay
cases.text: Matches each guest with the next stay, dining or rewards add-on that fits their trips. Replaces blanket promotions with one targeted offer per guest in the channel they use.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep guests engaged between stays
cases.text: Personal nudges in the app, push and email, based on each guest’s rewards balance and past stays. Every guest gets a reason to open Radisson before the next booking.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
